title: NARUTO×NINKU
synopsis:
"I'm heading out on a mission for the ages, ya hear me?!"

Team 7 members Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura are given a mission by Kakashi.
Since Kakashi cannot participate himself, Naruto is appointed acting leader.
As a result of this decision, Naruto is fully motivated to make the mission a success.
However, on the way, Team 7 finds themselves lost in another world.

What appears before the bewildered trio is a boy with a face resembling a frog's, named Fūsuke.
What awaits them in this strange new world?

(Source: NARUTO x NINKŪ Official Site) 

Note: The official website for the NARUTO anime franchise announced a new anime project: to air four "brand-new" episodes to celebrate the TV anime's 20th anniversary back in 2022. 

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
